issues.description: Field 'rides' in class ExcellenceLand: the problem statement (task description) requires the attribute 'rides' to be declared private and of type List<Ride>, but the solution implementation declares this field as public (public List<Ride> rides). This visibility mismatch contradicts the specified encapsulation requirement and can confuse students about the intended access level for the attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the visibility of the 'rides' field in ExcellenceLand from public to private in the solution: replace 'public List<Ride> rides;' with 'private List<Ride> rides;'. Keep or provide the public getter getRides() so external access remains through the accessor, matching the problem statement's encapsulation requirement.
